title: Rain City coastal broadleaf cluster

authors.Rico Cilliers: Leaf photography and source material maps (CC0-1.0)

changes: Original 240-leaf, folded-surface thicket with eighteen stems, using seven leaf regions from the existing licensed Shrub 04 color/alpha/normal/material atlas. Original alpha and 1K material maps retained. Geometry, clustering and slope orientation are a coastal planting interpretation, not a species survey.
